_comment: Stable IDs for the new-task pipeline. No secrets here — credentials live in the .env referenced by AGENT_RULES_ENV. The project_key / assignee_account_id / team_id / repo come from your answers; the issuetype_id / board_id / sprint_field / team_field are generic Jira-Cloud defaults — regenerate them for your instance with discover.py if ticket creation fails. The Korean notion.prop_* values (prop_title, prop_start_date, prop_work_type) are schema-bound Notion property names and must match the live Notion workspace schema exactly — do not translate them.
